text:
Riya (PM): Quick sync — we need to align on launch gates for the routing policy work (multi-region + tenant isolation). Customer asks piling up and Q2 roadmap needs concrete pass/fail criteria.

Jorge (Infra): Can we list the minimal telemetry we need to call this "iso-ready"? latency p50/p95, tail CPU/GPU utilization, cross-region egress bytes?

Anya (Arch): Minimal = p50/p95 token latency, cross-region failover time, and mismatch rate for model variant fallbacks. Also need tenant affinity hit rate > 99% for isolated lanes.

Sam (SRE): Ops constraints: during cutover we need a canary window and automatic rollback trigger if error budget drops > 2% in 5m. Also add alerting for KV cache miss surge.

Kai (Sales): From customers: EU regulated customers want 0 cross-region routing by default and a documented DR playbook. Also important: signed SLA language for isolation.

Riya (PM): Sounds good. Proposal for launch gates (draft):
- Perf: p95 <= 1200ms for 2k token average workload
- Stability: error rate < 0.5% sustained during 30m canary
- Affinity: tenant affinity >= 99% for isolated slices
- Failover: cross-region fallback completes within 8s when enabled
- Cost delta: expected per-token cost increase <= 15% vs baseline

Jorge (Infra): Cost delta depends heavily on batching/kv cache behavior. We should capture workload shapes (seq length distribution) to estimate cost. I'll attach a quick query next.

Anya (Arch): Also recommend a non-functional requirement: routing policy must be expressible as policy-as-code (yaml snippet) so Sales/PS can map customer asks to features. Example: 

```yaml
policies:
  - name: eu-data-residency
    match: region == "eu"
    action: route: "eu-isolated-pool"
```

Sam (SRE): +1 for policy-as-code. Ops will need a dry-run mode for 72h to validate affinity without moving production traffic.

Riya (PM): Decision checklist for roadmap priority: 1) number of customers blocked (Kai to quantify), 2) regulatory need (high for EU finance), 3) engineering cost (Jorge estimate), 4) risk surface for SRE (Sam). If top 2 scores are high, we pull into Q2.

Kai (Sales): I have 3 customers flagged and 1 inbound RFP. I'll push numbers by EOD.

Jorge (Infra): Query attached (DeployBot uploaded) with per-tenant seq-length histograms and current affinity rates.

DeployBot: upload: 1758001278-routing-telemetry-sample.csv :white_check_mark:

Anya (Arch): Next steps: Riya to collate the checklist + gate definitions into a one-pager; Jorge to provide cost delta estimate and histogram summary; Sam to draft canary/rollback playbook; Kai to confirm customer counts. Sync Wed 10am.

Riya (PM): I'll own the one-pager. Putting a TODO in calendar. Thanks all :thumbsup:
__notes: Do not include a title field. This thread is a product<>architecture cross-functional sync on routing/isolation launch gates.
